research_question: Does a parameter-free morphology-to-waveform consistency objective improve held-out development-subject reconstruction on MMECG and CR_RVS?
hypothesis: B1 should improve full-window PCC, RMSE/MAE/R2 and waveform-derived timing on both datasets, and outperform B2 if cross-output transfer adds value beyond direct local supervision.

arms.B1: Same network, detached morphology-head consistency weight 0.05
arms.B2: Same network, direct reference-cycle control weight 0.05

controlled_variables: Within each dataset: split, initialization seed, preprocessing, architecture, optimizer, 80-epoch budget, patience 20, event/shape losses and evaluator
checkpoint_selection: best_loss.pt selected by the common validation base loss, which excludes the candidate consistency term
evaluation_split: validation only; test split is not read by the evaluator or training loop
decision: Advance only if B1 improves both datasets without a material amplitude/timing regression and adds evidence beyond B2; otherwise reject or revise the candidate.
